items.title: Uber Becomes McDonald’s “Preferred Delivery Partner” in 14 Markets as Its DoorDash Fight Widens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMcDonald’s named Uber the preferred delivery partner for orders placed in its own app, as part of a multi-year expansion across 14 markets for a McDelivery business that brings in more than $20 billion a year. The deal comes days after another big-brand delivery deal, so Uber has now signed two of the biggest consumer brands while DoorDash works through its deal to buy Instacart.

items.title: Wall Street Turns Bullish on Uber as Profitability Strengthens Its Growth Story
items.summary: Uber's profits are surging, yet the stock still sits far below its high and a driver shortage keeps nagging at the story. Can a cheap multiple and a robotaxi push outrun the risks hiding in the fine print?
